title: Search bar
description: A search field with a clear button. The magnifier reacts when you click into the field, and the cross icon appears once you stop typing.

fragments.title: Define the element
fragments.note: Built-in triggers only. What each icon follows is written in its markup.

fragments.title: The field
fragments.note: Two attributes on the wrapper. Each icon follows one of them.

fragments.title: The clear button
fragments.note: state="in-reveal" is why the cross draws itself in.

fragments.title: When the clear button appears
fragments.note: From shared/ui/field.ts: half a second after the typing pauses.

fragments.title: Hidden but still taking up room
fragments.note: From shared/ui/field.css. The stylesheet reads the same attribute the icon does.
